panel.heading: Repeating trip
panel.summaryWithFuture: {summary} · {count, plural, one {# upcoming date on the board.} other {# upcoming dates on the board.}}
panel.summaryAllDone: {summary} · every date has departed or been cancelled.
panel.applyToSeries: Apply this date's details to every upcoming date
panel.applyDescription: Copies this date's title, description, capacity, pricing, and dive plan onto every upcoming date. Each date's own time, crew, roster, and conditions stay put; a date already carrying more divers than the new capacity is left alone.
panel.stopRepeatingDescription: Keeps every date already on the board and stops adding new ones. You can start it up again from here.
panel.startRepeatingDescription: Puts the next {days} days of this trip back on the board, and keeps them there.
panel.editCadenceDescription: Adding a day puts it on the board straight away. Removing one leaves the dates already scheduled alone — you'll be shown them, with who's booked, and asked.
panel.offCadenceHeading: {count, plural, one {# date on the board is no longer part of this run:} other {# dates on the board are no longer part of this run:}}
panel.offCadenceDateBooked: {date} — {count, plural, one {# diver booked} other {# divers booked}}
panel.cancelOffCadence: {count, plural, one {Cancel that date} other {Cancel those # dates}}
panel.offCadenceDescription: Takes them off the public schedule. Reinstate any single one from its own trip page.
panel.offCadenceDescriptionBooked: {count, plural, one {# of them has divers booked — they keep their bookings and their history, and you'll want to tell them.} other {# of them have divers booked — they keep their bookings and their history, and you'll want to tell them.}} Leave this alone and the dates simply stay on the board.
panel.cancelDescription: {count, plural, one {Takes the remaining # date off the public schedule.} other {Takes the remaining # dates off the public schedule.}} Also stops the trip repeating, so the dates don't come back. Reinstate any single date from its own trip page.

notices.seriesApplied: Those details now apply to every upcoming date in this series.
notices.seriesAppliedPartial: Applied to the upcoming dates in this series. A few already had more divers than the new capacity, or already had a roll call recorded past the new dive count, so those were left as they were — adjust them from their own trip pages.
notices.seriesCancelled: Cancelled every upcoming date in this series. Reinstate any single date from its own trip page.
notices.seriesRepeating: This trip repeats again — the next few months of it are back on the board.
notices.seriesCadenceSaved: Saved. The board matches the new days from here on.
notices.seriesCadenceNarrowed: Saved — but some dates already on the board are no longer part of this run. They're listed below with their head counts; nothing has been cancelled.
notices.seriesOffCadenceCancelled: Those dates are off the public schedule. Reinstate any single one from its own trip page.
notices.seriesStopped: Stopped repeating. Every date already on the board stays exactly as it is; no new ones will be added.
notices.seriesError: That series change didn't go through. Try again from a scheduled date in the series.
